figures.finding: Liechtenstein has no film agreement or film fund of its own to speak of: its documentary makers worked without professional film infrastructure and with no state film funding to speak of, and the state's Cultural Foundation (Kulturstiftung Liechtenstein) gave audiovisual media five per cent of its 2019 budget, chiefly to the Skino cinema and two film clubs.
figures.applies: Liechtenstein; Compendium of Cultural Policies country profile (read 2026-11-01).

sources.said: As there was no professional infrastructure for film production in Liechtenstein, intensive in terms of materials, personnel and costs, and no state film funding to speak of, they were largely limited to low-cost video productions. … The Liechtenstein Cultural Foundation supported the project and has also concluded performance agreements with the Skino Film Club and the Liechtenstein Film and Video Club. A total of five per cent of the Cultural Foundation’s 2019 budget went towards audiovisual media.

figures.finding: German is the national and official language of Liechtenstein.

sources.said: Art 6 The German language is the national and official language.

figures.finding: Vaduz is the capital and seat of Parliament and Government; no production centre is named in any source found.

sources.said: Vaduz is the capital and the seat of Parliament and the Government.
